title: Multi-Provider Router and Analytics: From Single-Provider to 7-Model Gateway
summary: Work journal recording the transformation from a Gemini-only proxy to a 7-provider router with SQLite analytics, four review fixes, and lessons learned.
notes: Dated retrospective journal (What Happened / Lessons Learned / Root Cause Analysis); 'Status: Resolved' is post-mortem metadata, not ADR status.
